title: Beyond On-Policy vs. Off-Policy: At What Level Should LLM Agent Distillation Follow the Student?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. While both have proven effective, we argue that this distinction is inherently hierarchical: the policy that induces an interaction history need not be the same as the policy that generates the token prefix of the current action. We introduce a hierarchical agent distillation framework that formalizes these two levels of on-policiness and enables explicit control over their pairing, mixture proportions, and training schedule. We study this problem through self-distillation, where a frozen teacher has access to task guidance unavailable to the student, and conduct a three-stage controlled study across three models and four interactive environments. translated_title: 超越同策略与异策略之分：LLM智能体蒸馏应在何种层级上跟随学生？
translated_abstract: 蒸馏交互式LLM智能体需要在教师生成的演示与学生生成的经验之间做出选择，这大致对应于异策略与同策略蒸馏。尽管两者均已被证明有效，但我们认为这种区分本质上是分层级的：引发交互历史的策略不必与生成当前动作token前缀的策略相同。我们提出了一个分层智能体蒸馏框架，将这两个层级的同策略性形式化，并实现对它们的配对方式、混合比例和训练日程的显式控制。我们通过自蒸馏来研究这一问题，其中冻结的教师可以获取学生无法获得的任务指导，并在三个模型和四个交互环境中开展了三阶段对照研究。我们发现，学生引发的交互历史与教师生成的动作前缀相配对，通常能够提供……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出分层智能体蒸馏框架，将同策略性分解为交互历史与动作前缀两个层级并实现显式控制，发现“学生生成的历史+教师生成的动作前缀”的组合通常是最优的蒸馏方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hierarchical agent distillation framework that decomposes on-policiness into interaction-history and action-prefix levels with explicit control over their pairing, finding that student-induced histories paired with teacher-generated action prefixes generally yield the best distillation performance.
